args.root_cause: `Page.total_pages` in `library/pagination.py` computes the page count with floor division (`self.total_items // self.page_size`) instead of ceiling division. For 11 items and page_size 5 this yields 2 instead of 3, so `has_next` (`page_number < total_pages`) returns False on page 2 and the final partial page (item 11) is never offered. The fix is to round up, e.g. `-(-self.total_items // self.page_size)` or `(self.total_items + self.page_size - 1) // self.page_size`. The slicing in `paginate` is correct.
